name: twinkle_collection
title: TWINKLE collection optics
summary: Fluorescence collection: 18.4 mm entrance pupil, fold mirror, achromat pair, dichroic mirror, filter, aspheric condenser and a 2.5 mm detector aperture. Fields to 12°.
lede: The fluorescence collection optics of the TWINKLE microscope: an 18.4 mm entrance pupil, a 45° fold mirror, an achromat pair, a dichroic mirror, a filter, an aspheric condenser and a 2.5 mm detector aperture, for fields up to 12°. Optiland's ray tracing reproduces Zemax's stored semi-diameters and, with the Zemax apertures applied, its relative-illumination roll-off.

not_working.detail: The ray-path plot has no lenses and its projection is unreliable, so it does not show the real layout. Treat it as a debugging aid only.
